on-task-complete.command: node -e "const os = require('os'); const exec = require('child_process').exec; let cmd = ''; if(os.platform()==='win32'){cmd='powershell -c \"(New-Object Media.SoundPlayer \\\"C:\\\\Windows\\\\Media\\\\chimes.wav\\\").PlaySync();\"';} else if(os.platform()==='darwin'){cmd='afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff';} else if(os.platform()==='linux'){cmd='paplay /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga';} exec(cmd, (err) => { if(err) console.error(err); });"
